title: Group Product Manager - AI Experience
location: Germany, Bosnia, Norway, Estonia, Netherlands, Hungary, Portugal, Poland, Austria, Finland, Albania, Ireland, Bulgaria, Denmark, Belgium, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Croatia, Spain, Greece
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
Your main goal will be to lead n8n's AI Experience group: the teams that shape how people build agents and workflows with AI, how they come to trust what they've automated, and how n8n grows into a self-healing, self-improving platform.
You'll lead the PMs behind the AI Assistant, Agents and AI Trust across four areas:
Lead and grow a team of PMs
 - Lead the PMs of the AI Experience group (today AI Assistant, Agents and AI Trust), owning hiring, performance and career growth.
 - Build PMs who make strong decisions on their own, so the group doesn't depend on you or other leaders to decide.
 - Raise the bar for product craft across the group as the team and its scope grow.
Set the direction for AI Experience
 - Set a clear strategy across three themes: building great agents and workflows with AI, helping users trust their automations, and evolving n8n into a self-healing, self-improving platform.
 - Make considered bets, decide what not to do, and keep the roadmap ambitious but achievable with Engineering and Design leadership.
 - Give your teams clear missions that fit the bigger picture of n8n, and stay close to the other product groups (Capabilities, Enterprise and later Platform) as priorities shift.
Stay hands-on
 - Use the product every day, talk to the people building with it, and form your own view.
 - Co-shape work with your PMs: probe their thinking, challenge assumptions and course-correct where needed.
 - Partner with Engineering, Design and Data so the group delivers its outcomes consistently.
Improve how n8n builds products
 - Shape how PMs, designers and engineers work together in an AI-native org where engineers take on more decisions.
 - Improve product and engineering ways of working across n8n, starting with your own group.
 - Bring in go-to-market, Security, Legal, Finance, Developer Relations and model providers where decisions cross over.
REQUIREMENTS
Must-haves
 - PM leadership: You've managed at least two PMs and stayed hands-on with their work, and you can point to people who got better under you.
 - Product craft: You have sharp product sense, think in systems and can turn a vague problem into something concrete.
 - AI fluency: You use AI heavily in your own work, have built something with agents (a prototype counts) and know evals and harnesses well enough to probe your PMs on them.
 - Group-level strategy: You've set direction for a product group spanning several products and teams.
 - Process mindset: You improve how product and engineering work together, and you're comfortable with engineers owning more decisions.
 - Influence without authority: You align Engineering, Design and peer groups through clarity and trust.
Nice-to-haves
 - AI products in production: You've shipped AI or agent products to real users, ideally with evals running in production.
 - Technical users: You've built for people who write code or workflows, or worked in an open-source ecosystem.
 - Startup pace: You've worked in a fast-growing, remote-first startup and enjoy the entrepreneurial side of it.
 - Org change: You've led a product team through scaling or restructuring.
 - Technical skills: You can read code, query data with SQL or prototype with agents.
Why join us?
You'll lead our AI Experience group as its first dedicated GPM, and build it from here: the PMs, the strategy and how the teams work. We're hiring you to make the calls, so most product decisions in the group will sit with you.
The problems are hard and mostly unsolved. Helping people build agents they can rely on, getting them to trust automations that run without anyone watching, and turning n8n into a platform that spots and fixes its own failures are all open questions. You'll get fast, honest feedback on every bet from a fair-code community of 115k+ members and 207k+ GitHub stars.
You'll also help work out what product leadership looks like when engineers take on more of the decisions. That's still taking shape at n8n, and you'll have a real hand in it.
We're growing fast. We hit $100M ARR in 2026, and SAP's strategic investment in May valued n8n at $5.2B, more than double our Series C valuation seven months earlier. We're aiming to build a trillion-dollar company, and AI Experience is central to getting there.
We're remote-first and async by default, and you'll work with people who care a lot about what they build and are easy to work with.
If you want to lead the AI core of n8n, we'd like to hear from you!
n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
We can sponsor visa

title: Founders Associate (w/m/d) - New Venture
description:
Enpal ist Deutschlands führendes Energie-Tech-Unternehmen. Unsere integrierte Plattform – Solar, Speicher, Wallbox, Smart Meter, Wärmepumpe, Dämmung – vernetzt tausende Systeme über KI-gestützte Optimierung und definiert, wie Haushalte Energie produzieren, speichern und handeln.
Ab Beginn Q4 starten wir mit dem Aufbau eines neuen Kernproduktes: Klimaanlagen. Greenfield. Und die nächste Marktführerschaft für Enpal.
Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.
Warum du Teil dieses neuen Ventures werden solltest: 
 - Greenfield approach: Als Mitarbeiter #4 dieses neuen Ventures baust du das Geschäft von Grund auf mit auf. Keine starren Prozesse – gefragt sind vielmehr unternehmerisches Gespür, Intuition und die Fähigkeit, ein Geschäft erfolgreich zu skalieren.
 - C-Level exposure: Das Projekt wird direkt von unserem Gründer und CEO Mario Kohle unterstützt. Das bedeutet viel Gestaltungsspielraum und ein außergewöhnlich hohes Umsetzungstempo.
 - Best-in-class team: Du arbeitest eng mit einem Senior Manager (ehemals BCG) und einem erfahrenen Go-to-Market-Experten zusammen. Flache Hierarchien treffen auf maximale Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit. Im zweiten und dritten Quartal hat dasselbe Team erfolgreich die Marktführerschaft von Enpal im Bereich Dämmung aufgebaut.
 - Real Ownership: Du wirst nicht einfach nur das operative Geschäft unterstützen, sondern als strategischer Gestalter ein neues Kernprodukt von Enpal maßgeblich mitentwickeln.
DEINE AUFGABEN
 - Übernimm die vollständige Verantwortung für unsere ersten Pilotprojekte im „Founder Mode“: von der Kundengewinnung und Projektplanung bis zur operativen Unterstützung vor Ort während der Installation.
 - Quantifiziere das Marktpotenzial unseres neuen Geschäftsvorhabens und führe fundierte Machbarkeitsanalysen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Expertennetzwerk von Enpal durch.
 - Bereite strategische Unterlagen für Abstimmungen mit der Führungsebene (C-Level) vor und unterstütze das Management direkt bei der Entscheidungsfindung.
 - Entwickle und implementiere skalierbare Vertriebs- und Betriebsprozesse, um unsere Produkte erfolgreich in ganz Deutschland auszurollen.
 - Organisiere interne Workshops, um zusätzliche Wachstumsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Organisation zu stärken.
DEIN PROFIL
 - Ein hervorragender Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss einer renommierten Business School.
 - Berufserfahrung oder Praktika in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen, z. B. einem Start-up, oder in der Unternehmensberatung.
 - Eine proaktive und stark lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.
 - Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme herunterzubrechen und strukturiert nach dem Top-down-Prinzip zu kommunizieren.
 - Ausgeprägtes praktisches Urteilsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, mithilfe des 80/20-Prinzips konsequent Prioritäten zu setzen.
 - Eine engagierte Arbeitseinstellung mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative und Eigenverantwortung.
 - Erfahrung darin, in einem dynamischen Arbeitsumfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und gleichzeitig bei den wichtigsten Aufgaben 100 % Leistung zu erbringen.
 - Hohe Qualitätsansprüche an sich selbst und andere sowie eine „Can-do“-Mentalität, die das eigene Umfeld motiviert.
 - Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️
DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN
 - Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.
 - Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen.
 - Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

title: Staff Product Manager (Platform & Engagement)
description:
ABOUT US
At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people.
THE ROLE
Everything people do on Pencil runs on the platform. It covers how a new user reaches their first finished piece of work and keeps coming back, and how an enterprise client sets up its brands, people and rules once and then runs many workspaces from one place. It also covers how production work runs repeatably through workflows that start from, and end in, the systems a client already uses. This role leads the product team that owns all of it.
You will lead the Platform vertical as its Staff Product Manager. The vertical covers both the core product squads and the client teams that handle platform needs for individual clients. The core squads own three areas. The first is the user lifecycle: onboarding, the homepage, notifications, retention, growth, self-serve billing and collaboration. The second is the enterprise lifecycle and brand context: workspace setup and governance, access control and single sign-on, metadata and taxonomy, and everything Pencil knows about each brand. The third is workflows. The client teams handle client-specific workspace, connector and integration needs, and custom work for individual enterprise accounts. Product managers own each area day to day, and you will guide them, set the standard for their work and make the calls that cross between them. You will also own brand context and the enterprise lifecycle directly, as its product manager.
Brand context is central to the role. Every ad Pencil's agents make is only as good as what they know about the brand. You will make Pencil the place where that knowledge lives: the brand's identity and guidelines, tone of voice, products and claims, audiences, assets and templates, legal and compliance rules, the work it has approved and the work that performed. You will own how that context is captured from the sources a client already has, how it is kept current, how it is governed from global brand to local market, and how every agent, workflow and person applies it. You will also measure whether it makes the work better.
Pencil's agents and editor build on what the platform provides. Brand context shapes everything agents make and everything scoring checks, and workflows carry most of the platform's production. Within the vertical, the client teams adapt the platform for individual clients and the core squads build what every client shares. You will decide which client needs belong in the core, agree with the engineering manager how the vertical's capacity splits between core and client work, and keep the platform coherent as it grows.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 - Set the strategy and charter for the Platform vertical: the durable problems, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list for each area.
 - Lead and develop the product managers in the vertical, set the standard for their work, and help each of them make better decisions.
 - Own onboarding across the whole product, so that every new user, whether they sign up themselves or are invited into an enterprise workspace, reaches a first finished piece of work quickly.
 - Bring customer obsession to the vertical. Own retention across the whole product, track how people feel about Pencil as closely as what they do in it, and use both to decide what to fix first.
 - Own the enterprise lifecycle, so that a client can set up once and run many brands and workspaces from one place, governed and auditable.
 - Own brand context as a platform capability, so that Pencil is the single, governed source of what every agent, workflow and person needs to know about a brand.
 - Capture brand context from the sources clients already hold, such as guidelines, asset libraries and past campaigns, with as little manual setup as possible, and keep it current as brands change.
 - Govern brand context from global brand to local market, with clear ownership, version history and approval of changes.
 - Prove that brand context improves the work, together with the teams that own ship-ready quality and scoring.
 - Keep Pencil ready for enterprise security and governance reviews, including access control, single sign-on and event logs.
 - Guide the client teams in the vertical on workspace, connector and integration work, so that what they build for one client uses and strengthens the shared platform.
 - Agree with the engineering manager how the vertical's capacity splits between core and client work, and revisit it as client demand changes.
 - Decide which client needs belong in the core platform, and make sure what you build serves every client.
 - Make the calls that cross pods within the vertical and with the Agents and Editor verticals, and bring the hard ones to a decision quickly.
 - Run planning for the vertical, quarterly for the core squads and monthly for the client teams, and report on progress against its objectives.
 - Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.
 - Partner closely with engineering and design leadership, the head of client services, sales and customer success.
YOUR BACKGROUND
You will have around twelve years of product management experience, including several years leading other product managers or a product area that spans several teams. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
 - A platform strategy you set for several teams, and how you kept them pointed the same way.
 - Taken multiple products from 0-1 and be able to explain your learnings
 - Product managers you developed, and how their decisions improved.
 - Enterprise administration, governance or security work you led in a SaaS product, and how you balanced control with ease of use.

title: Group Product Manager, AI Foundations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA
 Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. The bar is high and the pace is intense, and we like it that way. This isn’t a place for complacency. It’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits and do the best work of your career. If you’re ready to build the future of finance with a championship team who refuse to settle for “good enough,” you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for in-person working sessions
 As a Group Product Manager on the AI Foundations team within the Platform product group, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for the core AI building blocks that every team at Coinbase depends on. This team owns the LLM Gateway, model selection, MCPs, knowledge and context primitives, evaluations, and additional AI infrastructure that powers autonomous and assisted AI experiences across the company. You'll define how Coinbase builds, governs, and scales its AI capabilities, turning foundational primitives into reliable, secure, and high-leverage tools that accelerate product development and operational efficiency company-wide.
 What you’ll do: 
 Shape the multi-year vision for AI platform capabilities, identifying emerging technologies and industry shifts that inform investment priorities and architectural decisions.
 Own the end-to-end product roadmap and success metrics for AI Foundations, spanning model infrastructure, context and knowledge primitives, integration frameworks, and evaluation systems.
 Drive adoption of AI primitives across Coinbase product and engineering teams by building self-serve capabilities, clear documentation, and compelling internal developer experiences.
 Lead model governance strategy, defining how Coinbase evaluates, integrates, and manages large language models across cost, quality, latency, and safety dimensions.
 Partner with Engineering, Security, Legal, and Finance to ensure AI infrastructure meets Coinbase's standards for reliability, compliance, and responsible use.
 Required Skills and Experience:   
 10+ years of product management experience, with 5+ years focused on AI/ML platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure products used by internal engineering teams.
 Proven track record of defining and shipping platform primitives or developer-facing products that achieved broad internal or external adoption.
 Deep technical fluency in LLM architectures, model serving, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and agent-based systems, with the ability to engage directly with engineers on design tradeoffs.
 Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, security, legal, and finance in a fast-moving, regulated environment.
 Builds conviction with senior and executive stakeholders around ambiguous, high-stakes platform bets, articulating complex technical strategy, investment cases, and tradeoffs in clear narratives that drive alignment and resource decisions.
 Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
 Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 
 Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $243,865 — $286,900 USD 
 Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period.
 Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 
 US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. 
 Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . 
 Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes .

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
 About Pinterest: 
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the  flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 The Team 
 Pinterest's Infrastructure organization builds and operates the platforms that every engineer at Pinterest uses to build, test, ship and run software. Our CI and deployment platforms handle the journey of every change from commit to production. We're investing heavily in making that journey faster, more efficient and safe by default, especially as AI-assisted development sharply increases how much we ship. We work closely with engineering teams across Pinterest to make sure the platform scales with the business.
 What You'll Do 
 Lead cross-team programs that make production changes safe by default, driving adoption of progressive rollouts, automated canary analysis and fast rollback across code, config, data and ML model deployments.
 Drive the CI platform roadmap to reduce build cost and wait times, improve fleet utilization and migrate CI workloads to our next-generation compute platform.
 Define and track the delivery and reliability metrics that measure success, such as change failure rate, recovery time, lead time for change and build performance, and build dashboards that surface regressions early.
 Manage dependencies and migrations across CI, artifact, deployment and compute platforms and the many service teams that depend on them.
 Influence engineering teams across Pinterest to adopt new standards and paved paths, managing timelines, pushback and risk.
 Communicate technical tradeoffs among velocity, safety, cost and reliability clearly to audiences from individual engineers to senior leadership.
 Use GenAI as the default operating model for program execution: produce AI-assisted first drafts of core program artifacts, turn high-toil workflows into AI-first mechanisms (for example, intake triage, status synthesis, action and decision extraction, and risk and dependency tracking), and synthesize signals to surface risks, tradeoffs and escalation paths early.
 Prototype solutions that improve decisions with data (dashboards, analysis) or simplify processes (workflow helpers, internal tools) using AI coding assistants ("vibe coding").
 Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance and safety by design: handle sensitive data appropriately, validate AI-generated outputs, document assumptions and limits, and make sure AI-assisted workflows meet policy and compliance expectations before broad adoption.
 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of TPM experience leading complex, cross-functional technical programs in infrastructure, platform engineering, developer productivity or SRE.
 A solid understanding of CI/CD systems, build infrastructure and safe-deployment practices (canaries, progressive delivery, automated rollback), and the tradeoffs between velocity and safety.
 A track record of driving platform or standards adoption across many engineering teams without direct authority.
 Strong analytical skills, with experience defining delivery and reliability metrics (for example, DORA metrics) and using data to drive decisions.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including giving clear, candid status and risk updates to senior leadership.
 Comfort with ambiguity: you can take a broad mandate, define the plan and measures of success, and drive it to outcomes.
 Experience with infrastructure efficiency, compute cost or capacity planning is a plus.
 Workflow design, AI fluency, and a data-and-insights orientation: experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms and improving decisions using GenAI (for example, strong prompting, vibe coding lightweight scripts or tools, dashboards, data analysis and using agents where appropriate).
 Safety-by-design AI fluency: experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, data handling, output validation, auditability) and recognizing where AI use isn't appropriate or needs extra controls.
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience.
 Join us and help shape the future of Pinterest's infrastructure!
 Relocation Statement: 
 This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our  PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

 We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
 This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6 months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country

title: Product Lead - AI Finance
description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.
 This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Finance app areas.
 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.
 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.
 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.
 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.
 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.
 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.
 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.
 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.
 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.
 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.
 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.
 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.
 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.
 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.
 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.
 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.
 People who cannot go deep into product details.
 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.
 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.
 People who need large teams before they can create progress.
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam. 
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task

title: Product Manager – Plattform & KI (m/w/d)
description:
#### **Deine Aufgaben**
Falls du aus der Strategie Beratung kommst
Du hast genug davon, Konzepte zu schreiben, die andere umsetzen oder die in der Schublade landen? Bei uns setzt du selbst um. Du arbeitest nah an der Geschäftsführung, entscheidest mit und siehst nach zwei Wochen, ob deine Idee funktioniert. Statt Folien baust du Lösungen.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für einen Teil unserer Plattform. Du berichtest an unsere Head of Product und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Kunden und unserem Engineering-Team zusammen. Wenn du dich bewährst, ist der Weg zum Product Owner offen.
Woran du in den ersten Monaten arbeiten könntest
* **Embedded Finance:** Unternehmen sollen Finanzierung direkt in der Software anfragen können, die sie jeden Tag nutzen, zum Beispiel in Buchhaltungs- oder Branchenlösungen unserer Partner. Du baust das Produkt dafür mit auf.
* **Liquiditätsmanagement:** Wir wollen aus Finanz- und Buchhaltungsdaten erkennen, wann ein Unternehmen Kapital braucht, bevor es selbst danach fragt.
* **Partner- und Bankenplattform:** Vertriebspartner sollen Anfragen in Minuten einreichen und den Status live sehen. Banken sollen vollständige Unterlagen bekommen und schneller entscheiden können.
Was du machst
* Du findest heraus, wo es für Berater, Kunden, Banken oder Partner hakt, und machst daraus Lösungen.
* Du entwickelst die Roadmap für deinen Bereich und setzt sie um. Du schreibst nicht nur Konzepte.
* Du baust Prototypen, UX und UI selbst, mit KI-Tools wie Claude, Chat GPT oder Lovable und übergibst sie an Engineering, wenn sie funktionieren.
* Du prüfst kritisch, was die KI liefert, verstehst die Zusammenhänge dahinter und bringst Ergebnisse auf eine Qualität, mit der wir arbeiten können.
* Du leitest Projekte von der Idee bis zum Livegang und hältst alle Beteiligten zusammen.
#### **Dein Profil**
* 2 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Unternehmens- oder IT-Beratung, im Produktmanagement oder in einem Start-up.
* Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau.
* Du bringst Struktur in unklare Situationen, ohne dich hinter Prozessen zu verstecken. Du denkst den nächsten Schritt mit.
* Du nutzt KI im Alltag intensiv und hast Lust, damit Dinge zu bauen.
* Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugst Bankmitarbeitende genauso wie Entwickler.
* Du interessierst dich für Finanzen und Unternehmen. Bankerfahrung brauchst du nicht, das lernst du bei uns.
* Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Softwareentwicklung, DATEV, Buchhaltung oder Firmenbewertung
#### **Warum wir?**
Die DFKP ist Deutschlands führende bankenunabhängige Finanzierungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir haben über 6.000 Unternehmen begleitet, arbeiten mit mehr als 200 Banken und Finanzierern und haben seit Gründung über 210 Mrd. € vermittelt. Unsere Plattform haben wir selbst gebaut: für Kunden, Banken und Vertriebspartner.
Jetzt geht es weiter: Wir wollen Finanzierung direkt dort anbieten, wo Unternehmen ohnehin arbeiten, und aus Finanzierungsberatung echtes Liquiditätsmanagement machen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Produkte nicht nur verwaltet, sondern selbst baut.
#### **Über uns**
Als **Deutsche Firmenkredit Partner** (DFKP) ermöglichen wir dem deutschen Mittelstand hausbankunabhängigen Zugang zur passenden Finanzierung. Getreu unserer Maxime #einfacherfolgreichfinanzieren ist es unser Ziel, kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMUs) in jeder Unternehmensphase und bei jedem Finanzierungsanlass optimal zu unterstützen. Damit fördern wir Wachstum, ermöglichen Innovation und bieten Sicherheit für deutsche Mittelständler aus allen Branchen.
Im Zuge unseres Wachstums in 2026 suchen wir Verstärkung für unser Team! Wenn Du mehr erfahren möchtest, schau gerne auf unserer Website oder unserem LinkedIn Profil vorbei!

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Berlin
Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform. 
Built for enterprise scale and security, Talon.One helps businesses design and deliver incentives that drive real customer behavior.
Today, over 300 of the world’s most-loved brands including Sephora, Gymshark and Costa Coffee work with Talon.One to turn their incentives into a reliable growth engine.
**ABOUT THE TEAM:**
Our product team consists of specialists in frontend, backend, QA, technical writers and design, as well as engineering managers and product managers. We work in small collaborative cross-functional squads that are grouped into tribes. Each tribe owns a broad domain (Promotions, Loyalty, Ecosystem… ). We are kicking-off a new tribe to work on our B2B2C capabilities - and that's where your expertise would be needed.
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
As a Senior PM you will own the B2B2C Tribe. You will gather insights from our retailers, brands, internal stakeholders, and use your understanding of franchises, federated models, parent-subsidiary setups to translate the needs of those industries into a roadmap and execute on it. You will report to the VP of Product and help lay the foundation for a brand-new tribe. You'll lead the groundwork and discovery, understanding customer needs, and defining what the tribe should focus on first. You'll have a hand in how it's built, from helping hire the first team members to shaping how it works day to day, while building on the product culture already established across our other tribes.
**ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:**
* Develop a deep understanding of the retail and e-commerce landscape, specifically franchises and federated models
* Own discovery end to end: uncover what retailers and brands actually need through analysis, market research, and direct client engagement, and translate it into a clear product direction. Delivery will be owned by an Engineering Manager, so this role is about defining the right problem and outcome, not running the project
* Build strong relationships with our Technical Account and Integration Managers and our retail integration partners to facilitate the development of our features
* Work closely with other teams and actively collaborate across departments: including commercial, data, and engineering - to share your domain knowledge and drive alignment
* Define and track key metrics around your developed features impact to guide product decisions
**WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:**
* Strong understanding of B2B, SaaS and API-first products as well as the technical ins and outs of APIs in general
* 5+ years in product management, ideally in B2B, internal tooling, or any other domain in which the end user is not necessarily the end consumer. Domain experience in loyalty or promotions is welcome, not required
* Experience working in the early days of a product or team, where things have to be set up, and you've enjoyed figuring it out as you go
* Having the capacity to make decisions with incomplete information, being curious and pragmatic
* Being self-organized and outcome-oriented, with the ability to work independently and a strong sense of ownership
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in an agile setting applying Agile methodology (2-week Sprints, JIRA)
* Experience and curiosity when it comes to AI tools usage
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* A product & engineering team, now part of Adyen, building the incentives engine behind some of the world’s biggest brands
* Adyen+, a significant monthly allowance to spend on whatever matters most to you and your wellbeing
* 28 days of paid annual leave
* €115 monthly commuting allowance when you join us in the office 3 days per week
* 25% employer contribution to your pension
* Annual all-company gathering at Adyen’s headquarters in Amsterdam, plus regional team events throughout the year
* Opportunity to connect in person at Adyen offices across 29 locations worldwide

title: Senior Product Manager, Organic Growth (Berlin, hybrid)
description:
Your role at Kittl 🥁 
 Search is changing fast: people still use Google, but more and more answers happen inside AI tools, with zero clicks. Our organic leverage already sits in the product: high-ranking /create pages, a template library, comparison and directory pages, and strong branded demand. What's missing is someone who owns organic growth end to end: decides where Kittl bets, gets it built with engineering and is accountable for the results. You'll draw on expert SEO advice, but the calls are yours. Your title so far might have been Product Manager, Head of Growth or SEO Lead. What matters is that you've made the decisions and shipped the work at scale. This role sits in Product.
 What you'll do 📋 
 Own organic growth: Be the single person accountable for organic search and AI discovery, with targets you set and report against, starting with the US, our most important market
 Make the calls: Bring in expert SEO advice, weigh it against the data, and decide what Kittl bets on and what we stop doing
 Own the surfaces: Run the roadmap for our /create, comparison and directory pages: information architecture, page experience and templates
 Experiment and decide: Test, measure on signups rather than traffic, and decide what to scale, fix or retire
 Get it built: Write specs engineers can build from, secure capacity in cycle planning, and align product, engineering, design and content to ship
 Bring in what you need: Work with our SEO specialists and external experts, and decide what else your plan needs, from writers to dev time
 What you'll need ✅ 
 Organic growth decisions you owned: You've decided where to bet on organic, what to build and what to stop, and can show the results in signups, conversion or revenue, including the bets that didn't work. Deep technical SEO isn't required
 Scale: You've done this on a large website, ideally with 500k+ organic visits a month
 The US market: You've grown organic search in the US
 You get things built: You've written specs, won engineering capacity and shipped pages, templates or product changes with engineering, design and content. Recommendations alone don't count
 Data fluency: You're at home in Google Search Console, GA4 and a product analytics tool, and you run experiments with clear decision rules
 Product thinking: You think in roadmaps, bets and trade-offs, not checklists. Technical fixes are part of your plan, not the whole of it
 Nice to have 👌 
 Deep technical SEO or AEO expertise. It's a bonus, not a requirement: we bring in expert advice for the specialist depth
 Programmatic or template-driven pages at scale
 A freemium or self-serve SaaS funnel where organic feeds signups
 A design, creative-tools or e-commerce audience
 A consulting or founder background
 Show us, don't tell us 
 Tell us about one organic growth decision you made yourself: what you saw in the data, what you decided to build, how you got it shipped, and what happened to signups or revenue.
 Tools you'll work with 🧰 
 Ahrefs: keyword research, backlinks, competitor benchmarking and site audits
 Peec AI: how Kittl shows up in answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini
 Google Search Console and GA4: indexing, organic performance and conversion attribution
 Our internal AI data agent: connects Search Console, BigQuery and Metabase, so you can query organic performance alongside product and revenue data
 Interview process 🔍 
 Intro call with your recruiter (30 min)
 Hiring manager interview (45 min)
 Case study (60 min)
 Meet the team: engineering and product (45 min)
 Final interview (30 min)

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades and a generation of firm owners looking for a successor. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.
 The role
 We are transforming the tax advisory market with a dual strategy. We build verticalized services, starting with healthcare professionals. At the same time, we take over established firms whose owners are looking for a successor, a need that keeps growing as the market ages, and integrate them as we go. You work directly with our founders on making both work together: acquiring firms, integrating them and making them run on our platform. You own each workstream from the first question to a result you can see in the numbers, and you take on more of the group as it grows.
 Tasks
 M&A: Lead acquisitions, from market research and screening to firm analysis, business cases and due diligence. 
 Integration: Lead the workstreams that bring acquired firms into the group, from the first day after closing to stable operations. 
 Operations design: Build the playbooks, processes and KPIs we use to run a growing group of tax firms, and make sure they work on the ground. 
 AI and product rollout: Work with our engineering team to roll out our platform in our firms, automate manual workflows and track adoption and impact. 
 Founder-led projects: Own topics that cut across teams or have no owner yet, such as board and investor materials or financing processes, and drive them to an outcome. 
 Requirements
 2 to 3 years of experience: In strategy consulting, investment banking, private equity, transaction services or an operating role at a high-growth startup. 
 Financial fluency: You understand P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flows and build models that others can read and check. 
 Execution, not just analysis: You take your recommendation through implementation, including on the ground with the teams in our firms. 
 Clear judgement: You break down unstructured problems, separate facts from assumptions and decide even when the data stays incomplete. 
 AI-native: You use AI tools every day and build automations yourself. 
 German language skills: Our clients and the firms we acquire speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and strong English. 
 A plus, not a must: Experience in tax, accounting or another regulated market. 
 Benefits
 Work directly with experienced founders: Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder. 
 Build a new category: Shape how an AI-powered roll-up is built in one of Germany's largest professional services markets. 
 Ownership from day one: Own workstreams on live deals, firms and clients, with results you can measure. 
 Front-row seat to AI in the real world: See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it. 
 Room to grow: Take on more responsibility and your own area as the group grows. 
 Competitive salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact of your role. 
 The details
 Full-time, permanent position, start as soon as possible, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.
 How To Apply
 Send us your CV. Our process has four steps: a first call, a culture interview, a quantitative case study based on a real case from our work, and a final round with the founders. It is thorough, and we move quickly.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Machine Learning
description:
Who are we?
 Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
Why the Cohere TPM role?
As our Generative Machine Learning organization has continued growing, we are looking for more Technical Program Managers to join the team!
At Cohere, TPMs are pivotal to our success, being seen as operational experts specializing in cross-functional efforts. Great TPMs at Cohere are well-rounded, executing with precision at the tactical level, while partnering with senior leaders and shaping the big picture at a strategic level, and the opportunities are endless in growing the scale and impact of their work. Cohere’s TPMs would often be described as organized, execution-oriented, pragmatic leaders who are adaptable to the needs of the company and the programs they lead.
As a reward for the depth and breadth of expertize that you bring to the table, you will get to work alongside some of the most talented AI researchers and industry experts in the world on building cutting edge AI technology. No day will be the same as the one before, and the dynamic high growth environment will be absolutely perfect for anyone excited about solving novel problems, bringing structure to oftentimes chaotic and fast-paced environments, and ambitious about scaling their own impact and growth alongside the company!
 Please note: While we are remote-first and accept candidates from all over the world, we are highly prioritizing hiring for people who are within 1-2 hours of British Standard Time (BST).
 As a Machine Learning Technical Program Manager, You Will
 Establish, improve, and scale foundational processes that allow the Generative Modeling teams to execute better, faster, and more predictably
 Scale the operational capacity and effectiveness of the Modeling TPM team in collaboration with the Modeling TPM lead to ensure the function can remain lean and effective during a period of the program portfolio complexity and size continuing to rapidly increase
 Flexibly adapt to the needs of the company, programs, and the team from tackling long-horizon programs that can span quarters or even years to jumping onto often highly ambiguous short-term challenges that can have company-wide impact
 Partner directly with leaders within and outside of the Modeling organization on efforts to design, train and improve our core generative models
 Lead cross-functional, oftentimes company-wide programs and strategic initiatives, collaborating and coordinating with cross-functional teams such as Product, Engineering, Legal, Platform, Infra, Policy, and Finance
 Operate as an organizational expert in improving engineering execution rigor and operations on the ground, while contributing to the strategic layer in areas such as long-term strategic planning with senior modeling leadership
 Map out dependencies and risks, and ensure that cross-functional execution across the program runs smoothly, communicating status with non-technical and technical stakeholders and senior management
 Both own and enable a useful communication flow of priorities, ideas, and knowledge throughout and beyond the Modeling organization in line with your programs
 Respond quickly to program-level changes, clarifying new scope, and managing resource needs in response to evolving priorities
 You May Be a Good Fit If You Have
 5-10 years as a Technical Program Manager AND 5+ years of experience working directly on AI/ML. Strong preference for candidates that have worked directly in building foundation models.
 In-depth knowledge of machine learning, particularly when it comes to Natural Language Processing & Large Language Models (LLMs). Bonus points for experience with Multimodal AI.
 Experience with working in a chaotic, fast paced, low structure environment. We need someone who is pragmatic, can roll up their sleeves when needed, and can function at the tactical and strategic level to do whatever it takes to make Cohere’s models succeed
 Personal hands-on understanding of the unique challenges of managing projects and programs in the AI/ML development space as opposed to traditional software program management
 Managed projects & programs requiring a strong general business acumen, such as coordinating with Finance on reporting needs or Policy on regulatory compliance matters — the broader your experience beyond ML technical program management, the better!
 (optional, but preferred) Have technical experience in a hands-on capacity. We don’t necessarily need someone with hands on experience training models, but you need to feel comfortable sitting in the same rooms with some of the best researchers in the world, working on highly complex, cutting edge ML problems
 If some of the above - other than the ML TPM experience - doesn’t line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply! If you consider yourself a thoughtful worker, a lifelong learner, and a kind and playful team member, Cohere is the place for you.
We welcome applicants of all kinds and are committed to providing both an equal opportunity process and work environment. We value and celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive work environment for all.
 Full-Time Employees At Cohere Enjoy These Perks

title: Senior Project Manager for Power System Studies (m/f/x)
description:
About Us
 Since 1922, FICHTNER has been supporting exciting projects in the fields of energy, environment, renewable energies, water management, and consulting and IT as one of the leading independent engineering and consulting companies. In the Fichtner Group, you can expect a unique combination of a long-term oriented family business coupled with diversity, dynamism and flat hierarchies. We want to develop the infrastructure of tomorrow together with you and can offer you a wide range of development opportunities. To maintain our sustainable growth process, we are looking to fill a permanent position as
Electrical Engineer as Project Manager for Power System Studies (m/f/x)
 Your Tasks
 Lead, undertake and review power system studies in accordance with project requirements, applicable standards and agreed methodologies. 
 Apply appropriate tools to study tasks, including DIgSILENT PowerFactory, Siemens PSS®E and PSCAD. 
 Interpret study results, identify technical issues and develop clear, practical recommendations. 
 Prepare, review and approve technical reports, presentations, calculations and other project deliverables. 
 Provide technical guidance to project managers, engineers, clients and other stakeholders throughout project delivery. 
 Plan and coordinate technical work, including defining study scope, allocating tasks and monitoring progress and quality. 
 Provide technical oversight and quality assurance of work undertaken by colleagues and project partners. 
 Support, mentor and develop team members, sharing technical knowledge and promoting good engineering practice. 
 Build effective working relationships with clients, colleagues and external stakeholders; communicate complex technical matters clearly to different audiences. 
 Contribute to proposals, technical methodologies and other business development activities where required. 
 Promote a collaborative, accountable and safety-conscious working culture. Further notes: This role reports directly to the Director of Power System Studies in Electrical Systems and Networks Division.
 Key Requirements 
 Relevant degree in electrical engineering, power systems engineering or a closely related discipline. 
 Demonstrated professional experience of at least 10 years in power system studies and analysis. 
 Practical experience using one or, preferably, more of the following tools: DIgSILENT PowerFactory, Siemens PSS®E and PSCAD. 
 Ability to select and apply appropriate study tools and methods to meet project requirements. 
 Experience interpreting technical findings and presenting conclusions in clear, well-structured reports. 
 Proven ability to coordinate technical work and support delivery by multidisciplinary teams. 
 Strong people skills, including the ability to motivate, mentor and develop colleagues. 
 Client-focused approach and confidence engaging with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Willingness to travel to international projects locations, as may be required. 
 Fluent in English, German is desirable.
 Corporate Benefits
 To enable you to realise your full potential within Fichtner’s project environment, we offer you: 
 __Long-term stability & prospects:__ You will benefit from the stability and reliability of an independent family-run business, as well as long-term prospects and opportunities for personal development. 
 __Responsibility & flexibility:__ In your role, you’ll enjoy a high degree of freedom and personal responsibility. We also offer a flexible flexitime scheme and 30 days’ annual leave (for full-time roles). 
 __Modern working practices:__ We provide you with a modern digital infrastructure for mobile and flexible working. 
 __Development & Learning:__ Through structured induction and regular training opportunities, we actively support your personal and professional development. 
 __Mobility:__ We support your mobility with a subsidy towards the Deutschlandticket, a Job-Rad bike leasing scheme and our easily accessible locations. 
 __Health & Well-being:__ An E-Gym Wellpass and a wide range of company and sporting activities contribute to your health and well-being. 
 __Team spirit & corporate culture:__ At our Stuttgart site, you can use our staff canteen, whilst at other sites we provide digital meal options. Our regular team and company events strengthen team spirit. If you’d like to join our team, simply apply via our portal in just a few steps. We look forward to receiving your application!
